title: Encode and decode with a learned merge list
brief: Replay learned merges in order to encode text, join bytes to decode it, and check that the round trip is exact.
hints: apply_merges_to_word starts from ids = list(word_bytes). For each i, pair in enumerate(merges), call merge_pair([ids], pair, 256 + i) and keep the first list it returns.
encode loops over _pretokenize(text), turns each piece into list(piece.encode('utf-8')), replays the merges on it, and extends one flat list.
decode is b''.join(vocab[i] for i in ids).decode('utf-8'). Decoding one id at a time breaks on a character split across two tokens.
